# Generated Cadence regional core

Do not edit these files. The implementation lives in Cadence `src/`.
Run `npm run sync:cadence` from the editor with an adjacent Cadence checkout
(or set `CADENCE_ROOT`). This builds and copies only the browser-safe regional
entry point and its dependencies. `source-manifest.json` records SHA-256 hashes
of every input TypeScript source and generated JS/declaration file.

Normal editor install, tests and builds use this committed snapshot and do not
require a Cadence checkout, Node filesystem APIs at runtime, or native OpenCV.
